name: SpiderXO Connector
author: spiderxo

sections.description:
SpiderXO Connector opens exactly two fields over the WordPress REST API: the SEO title and the meta description that your active SEO plugin stores for each page and post. Without it, those fields are not available to REST clients, so a service you have authorised cannot update them.

It supports the SEO plugins Yoast SEO, Rank Math and All in One SEO. It looks for whichever one is active and opens only that plugin’s title and description fields. If none of them is active it does nothing.

What it does

  • Opens two fields of the active SEO plugin (its SEO title and its meta description) for reading and writing over REST.
  • Lets only a signed-in user who is allowed to edit that very post read or write them. Everyone else sees nothing in those two fields.
  • Adds one read-only status address, /wp-json/spiderxo/v1/status, for signed-in users who can edit posts. It says which SEO plugin was found and which two fields are open.

What it does not do

  • It makes no calls to any outside server and sends no data anywhere.
  • It does not track anyone, store anything, add settings, add admin screens, load scripts or styles, or show credits on your site.
  • It cannot install, update or delete plugins, create users or run other code. It does not read or change any other field.
  • It does not change your existing SEO data on its own. A change happens only when an authorised client writes to one of the two fields.

External services

None. This plugin does not connect to any external service.

Source code

The whole plugin is the single file spiderxo-connector.php, which is plain, readable PHP.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the Plugins screen, or upload the spiderxo-connector folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it. There is nothing to set up.
  3. To remove it, deactivate and delete it on the Plugins screen. Your SEO titles and descriptions stay exactly as they are, because they belong to your SEO plugin.
sections.faq:
Does it change my site by itself?

No. It only opens the two fields. Nothing changes unless an authorised client writes to them.

Who can read or write the fields?

Only a signed-in user who is allowed to edit that post, the same people who can already edit it in the editor.

What happens if I use a different SEO plugin, or none?

Nothing: it opens no fields.

Does it collect or send any data?

No.
